sources.title: Blockmedia: Binance names Kite (KITE) its 71st Launchpool project (relays the Binance announcement), published 2025-10-31 08:35 UTC
sources.excerpt: Total supply 10B KITE. Circulating at Binance listing ~1.8B (18%). Launchpool 150M KITE (1.5%), 85% BNB / 10% USDC / 5% FDUSD pools, farming 1-3 Nov. Spot listing 3 Nov with Seed Tag; pairs USDT, USDC, BNB, TRY. A further 50M KITE reserved for marketing six months after listing. No vesting schedule given.

sources.title: AiCoin mirror of Binance announcement 'Introducing Kite (KITE) on Binance Launchpool', published 2025-10-31
sources.excerpt: Spot trading 3 Nov 2025 13:00 UTC; Seed Tag applied; listing fee 0; available on Binance Alpha first. Contract 0x904567252D8F48555b7447c67dCA23F0372E16be on BNB Smart Chain, Ethereum and Avalanche. Initial circulating 1.8B (18%). (The mirror misprints total supply as 100B; Blockmedia and Phemex give 10B.)

sources.title: Foresight News (via AiCoin): KITE Foundation publishes tokenomics, published 2025-10-31
sources.excerpt: Total supply 10B. Ecosystem & community 48%; Modules 20% (rewards for AI service providers based on verified usage); Team, advisors & early contributors 20%; Investors 12%. No vesting terms given.

sources.title: ChainCatcher: Kite releases token economic model, published 2025-10-31
sources.excerpt: Same allocation (48/20/20/12) on 10B supply. Ozone testnet snapshot (interaction and social-binding data) completed; EOA wallet binding still open. No vesting terms.

sources.title: cryptonews.net: Kite tokenomics and utility explainer, published 2025-11-03 12:10 UTC (before 13:00 UTC listing)
sources.excerpt: Team allocation has 'multi-year vesting', investors follow 'vesting schedules' — no cliffs or durations. Launch-phase utility: module owners lock KITE in liquidity pools, builders must hold KITE. Mainnet-phase utility (not yet live): commissions from AI service transactions buy KITE, PoS staking, governance. 'Piggy bank' emissions: claiming forfeits future emissions. Mainnet not live at publication.

sources.title: Coinspot: Kite AI listing date announced — pre-market prices, published 2025-10-31 19:30
sources.excerpt: Pre-market perps: Bybit ~$0.17492 (up to 10x), OKX ~$0.17521 (up to 20x, fixed 0.03%/day funding), AsterDex $0.175–0.18 (5x, trading-points boost to 2 Nov). Utility in two phases (access/liquidity/builder incentives now; service fees, staking, governance later). No vesting schedule.

sources.title: CoinGabbar: Kite AI airdrop and listing date, published 2025-10-31
sources.excerpt: Same pre-market prints: Bybit ~$0.1749, OKX ~$0.1752, AsterDex $0.175–0.18. $33M total funding; backers include Samsung Next, Animoca, HashKey, 8VC, LayerZero Labs, Avalanche Foundation. No vesting schedule.

sources.title: Blockmedia: KITE pre-market perpetuals open on Binance Futures, OKX, Bybit and Aster, published 2025-10-30 05:40 UTC
sources.excerpt: Binance Futures, OKX and Bybit opened KITE pre-market perpetuals on 29 Oct; Aster opened a pre-launch market. OKX states the team had not finalised its token issuance plan and total supply was uncertain. Binance disclaimer: some product features still in development, utility may be limited.

sources.title: Blockmedia: Upbit lists Kite (KITE) on KRW/BTC/USDT markets, published 2025-11-03 08:17 UTC
sources.excerpt: Upbit trading from 3 Nov 22:00 KST, Ethereum network only, contract 0x904567252D8F48555b7447c67dCA23F0372E16be. Buy orders restricted ~5 min, limit-only ~2 h; pre-listing deposits subject to Travel Rule checks. Describes an L1 with stablecoin payments, programmable governance, three-tier identity and state-channel micropayments; staking/governance utility 'planned'.

sources.title: Bloomingbit: Upbit KITE listing notice, published 2025-11-03
sources.excerpt: Upbit KRW/BTC/USDT support, Ethereum network, same contract address; launch may be delayed if liquidity is insufficient. Links gokite.ai and gokite.ai/kite-whitepaper.

sources.title: Blockchain.news: OKX lists KITE spot and converts pre-market futures to perpetuals, published 2025-11-03 03:33 UTC
sources.excerpt: OKX KITE/USDT spot from 13:00 UTC 3 Nov after a 12:00–13:00 call auction; pre-market futures convert to standard USDT perpetuals (0.01–20x per this article) within three hours of spot opening.

sources.title: Newsfile: HTX opens trading for Kite (KITE), published 2025-11-03
sources.excerpt: HTX lists KITE spot, 10x margin and perpetuals on 3 Nov. Describes a PoS EVM-compatible L1 with 'Modules'; SPACE framework (stablecoin-native, programmable constraints, agent-first auth, compliance-ready, micropayments). Utility at TGE: module activation, ecosystem access, contributor incentives; commissions, staking and governance arrive at mainnet.

sources.title: Bitget press release: Bitget lists Kite (KITE), dated 2025-11-03
sources.excerpt: KITE/USDT spot on Bitget from 13:00 UTC 3 Nov in its Innovation/AI zone; Kite described as an EVM-compatible L1 aiming to be 'the first AI payment blockchain'. No metrics, tokenomics or mainnet status.

sources.title: PANews weekly preview: KITE claims open and Binance listing, published 2025-11-02
sources.excerpt: KITE Foundation airdrop checker live; claims open 3 Nov. Testnet and NFT snapshots completed. 1.8B (18%) initial circulating; 48% to community and ecosystem; 50M KITE for marketing after six months.

sources.title: Phemex News: Coinbase to launch KITE spot trading on 3 November (citing Wu Blockchain), published 2025-11-03
sources.excerpt: Coinbase adds KITE-USD spot on 3 Nov, live later that day subject to liquidity, in supported regions.

sources.title: Phemex News: Binance Launchpool introduces AI payment project Kite, published 2025-10-31
sources.excerpt: 71st Launchpool project; total supply 10B; initial circulating 1.8B (18%); two-day farming from 1 Nov; listing 3 Nov 21:00 UTC+8 on BNB Chain, Ethereum and Avalanche.

total_supply.note: 10B fixed total/max supply per Binance announcement (KITE-01, KITE-25) and KITE Foundation tokenomics (KITE-03)

circulating_supply.note: initial circulating at Binance listing (18%); figure originates with the project via the exchange announcement — not reconciled on-chain

market_cap_usd.note: DERIVED pre-listing snapshot: ~$0.175 pre-market perp price on Bybit/OKX (31 Oct, KITE-06, KITE-07) x 1.8B initial circulating. Perp pre-market, not spot; no spot price existed before 13:00 UTC on 3 Nov

fdv_usd.note: DERIVED: ~$0.175 pre-market price x 10B total supply

insider_allocation_pct.note: team, advisors & early contributors 20% + investors 12%. Modules (20%) and ecosystem (48%) excluded although both are foundation-administered

annualized_revenue_usd.note: mainnet not live; commission-based value capture only starts at mainnet (KITE-05, KITE-21). No protocol revenue at listing
